currentExecutionQueue.summary: Make the long-horizon P0-P9 skeleton machine-readable, mandatory in task context and protected against silent removal or renumbering.

Captured .artifacts/pluggable-stack/baseline.json for Fovea HEAD 7768ed083eee9c54ad86b7124a96f73a202d4c65 (dirty) and clean ImageCraft HEAD 05ab068c851d32a028f8556b2085a3266f0ee78c; content digest 94fa7a76dee3063c5757931143629d83f028e06f04bdd330b1945ec830330179.

The retained composition model and a seven-phase ImageIO lifetime ledger now pass. The ledger identifies prepared-state accumulation, framework-private allocations, output ownership transfer, alias composition and cancellation reclaim tails; held-out backend and real-device evidence remain open.

Fovea production pins are ImageCraft c16a868f1a1c0ed6b1a916ad082f762969ac5a7e (0.1.0-alpha.8) and Akashic 0376b960ec8abe54f2d4a9d7d66e97f395215eaf (0.1.0-alpha.7). Both component main branches are required-core CI green. Fovea has production host integration for ImageCraft animation admission and Akashic eviction reporting; protected Fovea release evidence and physical-device qualification remain open.
ADR-0014 is Accepted. Typed identity, partition-scoped deduplication, one active writer, new-generation migration and 30 named conformance obligations are frozen; implementation moves to P4.

Akashic 0.1.0-alpha.7 at 0376b960ec8abe54f2d4a9d7d66e97f395215eaf is public, MIT, required-core CI green and exactly pinned by Fovea. The current implementation includes compact manifest v2, dynamic global-unassigned memory budgeting and exact eviction reporting. Historical CacheLab V4 remains bound to alpha.5; physical power-loss/resource evidence and a current alpha.7 formal performance campaign remain open.

Extend the passing local process/logical-byte resource envelope to stable physical devices; add controlled ENOSPC, short-write, permission-transition, wrong-owner and long-running kill-at-random/power-loss evidence; then establish immutable release identity and protected CI. Reference-model, directory-overflow, negative-consumer and clean-copy gates are complete.

Fovea consumes Akashic 0.1.0-alpha.7 by exact revision and uses exact eviction reports to synchronize host rendered-cache residency. The production integration is current; historical alpha.5 fault/resource/performance artifacts retain their original source binding and do not automatically qualify alpha.7. Physical and protected release evidence remain open.

The historical 64 x 4 KiB full-manifest counterexample (~3.8033x) is superseded. Current Akashic first reached 1.1012x with per-key incremental records, then compact record v2 reduced metadata writes by 51.4% to 12,897 B and total logical write amplification to about 1.0492x without changing the per-key durable transaction boundary. Legacy v1 create/tombstone replay and future-schema/filename-key fail-closed checks are retained. Resource verification now enforces <=1.06x for 64 x 4 KiB, <=1.005x for 32 x 64 KiB and <=1.001x for 8 x 1 MiB. Physical NAND/write-cache/energy amplification remains under P4-EVIDENCE-001.

The privacy-sanitized Fovea public repository root already exists. main remains f4b320b7f995bc565f0ca5ef053a5cd5bfb3a3c7 and 0.1.0-alpha.1 is absent. A later candidate passed exact local qualification and hosted identity but full verification failed in a Workbench UI shard; final-candidate local qualification and fresh protected identity/full evidence remain mandatory before main/tag publication.

Fovea now exactly pins ImageCraft 0.1.0-alpha.8 at c16a868f1a1c0ed6b1a916ad082f762969ac5a7e. FoveaSystem compiles a production ImageCraftAnimationPlaybackPreparer and uses ImageCraft frame-window/whole-track cost estimates inside host-global animation admission while Fovea retains authorization, identity, cancellation and publication authority. Stable physical-iOS/resource evidence, same-semantics player comparison and protected release qualification remain open; no global performance claim is permitted.

Persistent-store provider and ImageCodec v1 remain the current conformance kits, and their manifests follow the exact production component pins. Earlier schema-4 Seatbelt campaigns remain historical source-bound evidence and are not rewritten to new component revisions. Current ImageCraft alpha.8/Akashic alpha.7 composition and host adapters are integrated; protected Fovea release evidence, real third-party implementations, stronger isolation and physical-device qualification remain open.

Every production and package-level codec composition requires ImageCodec. FoveaAdvancedSystem accepts only an immutable qualified persistent-store bundle binding provider identity, generation fingerprint, encoded/record/namespace persistence and lifetime. No legacy decoder path remains.
Run the V8-prepared W7 matrix plus W1/W2/W3/W8/W10/W13 from clean exact-pin source; quiet-host formal and physical evidence remain required.

Xcode 27/Swift 6.4 selection and local gates pass. Current ImageCraft alpha.8 and Akashic alpha.7 are green on xcode-27. Fovea Verification is active: 6cf identity passed, while full verification failed in a hosted Workbench UI shard; final-candidate qualification and fresh protected evidence remain the publication task.

ImageCraft 0.1.0-alpha.8 is public and xcode-27 CI green; it includes the bounded animation frame-window/whole-track cost contract consumed by Fovea. Historical progressive/animation mechanism evidence retains its original source binding. Stable physical-device presentation/resource/energy evidence remains open.

Akashic 0.1.0-alpha.7 is public and xcode-27 CI green and is Fovea's exact production pin. Current dynamic budget/eviction-report semantics are integrated; physical qualification and a current-source formal performance campaign remain open.

Fovea with the current Swift 6.4 ImageCraft/Akashic revisions passes local composition tests. Seven macOS adapters, seven iOS adapters and Apple/Fovea SwiftUI surfaces build under the locked comparative contract. No performance or Phase 1 claim is permitted; protected clean-copy CI remains open.

PipelineCache was split from one 945-line production file into a 233-line coordination base, 287-line transport-handoff extension, 125-line rendered-cache extension and 328-line persistence extension. The FoveaCore cohesion review was rebound to the 57-file set without weakening the 500-line file gate or creating a dependency cycle; the structural-quality gate passes.

Added CH-TRANSPORT-BUFFER-ISOLATION-024 from the locked Kingfisher native buffer-side-effect test mechanism. Fovea now proves that caller mutation cannot alter a finalized verified response body and that append/finalize after finalization fail closed. The challenge is mapped to W6; native upstream failures remain independent evidence and no ranking claim follows.

Closed a transport-verified handoff purge race exposed by the full parallel suite. Purge and namespace cleanup now advance a publication epoch, remove only indexed bodies, and leave the shared root intact until store destruction; directory security preparation is serialized without serializing payload copies. In-flight preparations admitted before purge cannot publish afterward, filesystem failures caused by a superseding cleanup normalize to cancellation, and concurrent insertion tests no longer suppress errors. The 478-test suite passed twice consecutively in full parallel mode.

All seven configured comparator integrations passed the locked build/structural contract in the recorded campaign. That evidence establishes compatibility only. The old dirty-workspace blocker is not a current-source claim; current develop is committed, but formal ranking still requires a fresh exact-candidate/quiet-host campaign plus stable physical-device evidence and all preregistered entry blockers.

Raised the engineering target from at-least-one practically superior endpoint to endpoint-by-endpoint dominance. Every applicable L2 primary endpoint must beat every eligible comparator by a preregistered substantial margin (default 20%) or prove a machine-checkable optimal floor; at least 80% of applicable L3 endpoints must be substantially superior and none may be materially inferior. Aggregate scores and post-result comparator removal remain forbidden.

The released NSLock SIEVE baseline remains authoritative. Four speculative directions were rejected by paired evidence: os_unfair_lock improved throughput but materially regressed p99; pthread rwlock improved p99 but collapsed throughput; generic optional slots regressed both; sharded reads either regressed writer tails or, with a writer gate, regressed all primary endpoints. A direct pthread mutex did not clear confidence-bound dominance. The next optimization must reduce exact SIEVE critical-section work without changing iOS 15 support or endpoint semantics.

The earlier D5 campaign proved the then-bound Akashic incremental-manifest implementation above the preregistered 20% margin for write throughput, read throughput and read p99. Akashic has since advanced to public alpha.7 and Fovea pins that exact revision. Preserve the D5 result as historical source-bound evidence; current alpha.7 requires a new clean formal campaign plus physical I/O/energy qualification.

The V4 eight-shard/twenty-block campaign passed all thirteen applicable comparisons and was published on the measured alpha.5 line. Fovea now pins Akashic alpha.7 with different dynamic unassigned-budget and eviction-report semantics. The V4 result remains historical; current alpha.7 needs new formal and physical evidence rather than a revision rebind.

Cache Lab V4 remains a valid thirteen-of-thirteen local formal result for its exact Akashic alpha.5 source. It cannot certify the current alpha.7 implementation. A new clean alpha.7 campaign, protected Fovea evidence and physical-device qualification are required before any current-stack cache dominance certificate.

Cancellation handoff uses a known-remaining-byte bound and retained compatibility fallback, with ComparativeLab separating completed versus abandoned post-cancellation bytes. Production tests remain green. The prior dirty-source diagnostic is historical; current exact-candidate formal calibration, stable-device resource tails and release evidence remain pending.

The package-internal default-off P7 derived-raster path now has alias-aware physical-byte accounting/eviction above Akashic, shared-container byte deduplication, in-memory second-chance recency, reopen reconciliation/GC, eager normal orphan cleanup and a restart-durable fixed-window logical write admission gate. Logical budget rejection carries the actual container-plus-projected-alias-manifest charge. W11_PT_040-048 plus pipeline coverage pass inside a 47-test derived-raster strict suite. Public/default admission remains off: clean W2/W11, physical write-amplification calibration, fixed-window burst policy, large-store reconciliation cost, eviction-policy comparison and stable-device energy/thermal/reclaim-tail evidence remain open.

Validated ImageRequest construction now caches namespace and fetch-base digests, removing repeated SHA-256 from rendered-memory authorization. Release microbenchmarks and five diagnostic W2 blocks show a stable local improvement, but Apple warm-memory display-ready remains faster because comparator delivery and pixel materialization dominate. Further work must preserve one request path and use clean stable-device evidence.

Same-source multi-target event subscribers now distinguish the transport owner from a subscriber that observed no progress. Response completion closes only the latter empty finalization and falls back to ordinary full-body decode, preventing an indefinite wait while preserving one origin transport. Adapter and root tests pass; clean W11 simulator and cancellation/revoke stress remain pending.

W5 retains the authorized encoded-animation seam, bounded frame/provider/peak accounting, platform presentation work and cancellation linearizability fixes. The former publication/adapter gap is closed on the development line: Fovea pins public ImageCraft alpha.8 and compiles the production preparer with frame-window/whole-track resource admission. W5 remains a workload capability gap until held-out corpus coverage, stable physical-iOS timing/memory/energy/thermal evidence, fair player-level comparator A/B, structural debt and protected release qualification are closed.

Close OPEN-FOVEA-PUBLICATION's local verification-routing and evidence-isolation gaps: apply downstream rules after every effective-profile transition, classify known Tool/performance/capture surfaces, retain premerge escalation for genuine unknowns, reject concurrent profile writers, and preserve digest-bound logs plus a source-bound report per run. Exclusive smart run 20260806T060153.388539Z-23894 passed 26 phases with 660/660 root tests at tree d7abaff9304b. Release, clean-copy, hosted and physical-device evidence remain open.

Fovea exact ImageCraft pin c16a868f1a1c0ed6b1a916ad082f762969ac5a7e remains behind host postconditions for complete-frame pixels, DecodeLimits, target geometry, resident bytes and source-profile consistency. Progressive output checks remain active, while pre-decode progressive peak semantics, AVIF/JPEG XL contract evolution, a second backend, hostile corpus/fuzz and device evidence remain open. Animation uses the separate alpha.8 frame-window/whole-track cost contract through the production FoveaSystem preparer.

Workbench project lifecycle is reproducible through XcodeGen 2.46.0 from project.yml and generic iOS Simulator build-for-testing succeeds. Static visual source audit has localization=0, layout=0 and asset findings=0 after making bundled real-media generation explicitly 1280px and replacing two undersized derivatives. WorkbenchVisualSystemTests validate actual bundle raster dimensions and pass 6/6 on iPhone 17e plus 6/6 on iPad Pro 11-inch M5. Subjective screenshot geometry, stable physical-device presentation and release evidence remain separate.

Revision 32 remains historical evidence for its migration-time ownership/quality snapshot and must not be projected onto later bytes. Current develop is a clean committed history, but release authority must be recomputed on the final exact candidate through the current continuity, source-identity and qualification gates; old untraced-path counts are neither current blockers nor current proof.

routeInvariants: Every multi-step Fovea task loads this manifest through the mandatory project context before changes.
P0 through P9 retain only current active or completed obligations; superseded implementation paths are deleted after durable decisions are normalized.
Planned, specified, implemented, calibrated, formally verified and release-eligible remain distinct states.
Dirty source may support local diagnosis and planning but cannot support trusted release evidence.
ImageCraft and Akashic are consumed only through current exact public revisions and isolated source identities.
Fovea retains HTTP, authorization, identity, namespace revocation, shared-work and cross-store commit state machines.
A second production codec cannot be admitted until resource-estimate coverage and codec conformance obligations are explicit.
New research changes the route only through a recorded adoption, rejection or supersession decision.
Maintainability repair is transaction-owned: unowned reviewable source drift remains candidate-authority work and must not force one change to refactor another actor's files.
A legacy conservative candidate/quality epoch begins at the migration-time Git HEAD tree; it never reconstructs earlier dirty state or swallows current dirty working-tree bytes.

Concurrency and lifecycle regression tests must mechanically establish the suspended, queued, pending, coalesced or restored state they claim; fixed Task.yield counts are scheduling hints and cannot serve as proof of admission or state transition.
